meta.name: vrm-mtoon-outline
meta.description: Adjusting VRM MToon material outline thickness in three-vrm. Covers outline width modes, property access, and how to fix outlines that appear too thick when models are scaled.

copy.tagline: 调整 VRM 模型 MToon 材质的轮廓线厚度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 three-vrm 中控制 MToon 轮廓粗细
copy.tagline_en: Adjust outline thickness of VRM MToon material
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control MToon outline width in three-vrm

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude能调整VRM模型的轮廓线厚度，特别是将轮廓宽度模式从“世界坐标”切换到“屏幕坐标”，使轮廓在模型缩放或相机靠近时保持粗细一致。还能诊断并显示轮廓材质的属性。
howto.when: 当用户处理VRM模型且轮廓线在缩放或相机移动时变得太粗或不一致，或需要以编程方式调整轮廓厚度时触发。

say.text: 把我的VRM模型轮廓切换到屏幕坐标模式，宽度设为0.005。
say.note: 切换后轮廓在缩放时会保持固定像素粗细。

say.text: 帮我诊断一下这个VRM模型的轮廓材质信息。
say.note: Claude会遍历模型并输出每个轮廓材质的模式、宽度等。

say.text: 将轮廓宽度模式设为世界坐标，因子为0.02。
say.note: 这样轮廓会随模型缩放而变粗。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to adjust VRM outline thickness, especially by switching outline width mode from 'worldCoordinates' to 'screenCoordinates' to keep outlines consistent regardless of model scale or camera distance. It can also diagnose and log outline material properties.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users need to adjust VRM model outlines that appear too thick on scaling, are inconsistent, or require runtime programmatic adjustment.

say_en.text: Switch my VRM model's outline to screen coordinates mode with width 0.005.
say_en.note: The outline will stay a fixed pixel size when zooming.

say_en.text: Debug the outline materials of this VRM model.
say_en.note: Claude will traverse and log mode, factor, etc.

say_en.text: Set outline width mode to worldCoordinates with factor 0.02.
say_en.note: Outlines will scale with the model.
